description: Retrieve the public status, license category, available terms information, and terms link for a specific public WEIR license ID (e.g. WRT2TVR2A). Returns found:false with code NOT_FOUND_OR_NOT_PUBLIC when the ID is private or doesn't exist; that never reveals whether a private license exists and is never permission. Next step: share terms_url so the person can review the terms on WEIR AI; any licensing decision is made by the person there. [Public, no account needed]
name: get_public_license
title: Get one public license
